description: KU Leuven and VITO researchers publish typical, extreme-cold and extreme-warm weather years for building-energy simulation at Kortrijk Kennedy Park, Belgium. Zenodo provides six public EPW and STAT files under CC BY 4.0. The provider says the years were extracted from a 2.8-kilometre convection-permitting COSMO-CLM climate run for 1976–2004, with urban canopy treatment and bias correction for temperature, radiation and humidity. The EPW files can drive alternative recent-past heating and cooling tests in EnergyPlus or other compatible building simulators. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this site-specific historical-climate trio. A limitation is that the selected typical and extreme years are model-based representatives, not a complete 29-year observed station series. Bias-correction details and uncertainty depend on cited methods, and the publication text contains an incomplete year for one reference. The paired future RCP 8.5 deposit is a distinct scenario resource. No EPW was downloaded or run.
